localChanges: JS -> TypeScript: class field declarations, parameter types, result interfaces (FlvTrack, FlvVideoSample, FlvAudioSample, FlvTrackMeta, FlvProbeResult, AmfValue, AvcSpsInfo, AacSpecificConfig, AacPacket); shapes and values as upstream.

Codecs not supported by the Otter pipeline removed and reported as CODEC_UNSUPPORTED: Enhanced FLV Opus / FLAC / AV1, legacy MP3 and PCM (av1-parser.ts, mp3 parsing not copied). SEI parsing (sei.ts) not copied; _parseSEIPayload is a no-op.
Imports of utils/logger.js and utils/exception.js point at Otter's src/otter/shims.ts (silent logger, same exception classes); '.js' extensions (NodeNext).

Bug fix: AAC AudioSpecificConfig change detection compared number[] with buffersAreEqual (byteLength undefined on both sides, so configs of different lengths with an equal prefix compared equal); now compared as Uint8Array.
self.navigator replaced by a guarded navigator read (Node / SSR / Workers without self).

Strict TypeScript: non-null assertions on index reads (scripts/vendor-strictify.ts), required callbacks asserted at call sites (upstream checks them at the top of parseChunks), meta objects typed as FlvTrackMeta when created empty, AAC packet as a discriminated union, keyframes removed with delete instead of = null, gb = null after destroy() dropped.
tsconfig: noUnusedLocals / noUnusedParameters off (bitstream parsers read syntax elements only to advance the reader); isolatedDeclarations off (never published).
